content:
Our Story

From India's Heartland to Your Home

Namo Narayana began with a simple belief: food should be as pure as it was in our grandparents' kitchens. We work directly with 5000+ farmer families across India's native regions to bring you ghee, oils, honey and more — made the traditional way, tested in certified labs, and delivered with zero preservatives.

Our Promise

  • Native ingredients sourced from their original growing regions
  • Traditional processing — Bilona churned, cold pressed, stone ground
  • 40+ quality checks on every single batch
  • Fair prices that empower rural farming families

Not high yield. Not lower cost. Just flavour, nutrition, and soul.
